question: If 10000x = (9982)2 - (18)2, then the value of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the algebraic identity **a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)**.

10000x = (9982 + 18) × (9982 − 18)

10000x = 10000 × 9964

**∴ The correct answer is 9964.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 10000x = (9982)² − (18)²

**Formula Used:** a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)

⇒ 10000x = (9982 + 18)(9982 − 18)

⇒ 10000x = (10000) × (9964)

⇒ x = (10000 × 9964) ÷ 10000

⇒ x = 9964

**∴ The correct answer is 9964.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Two Squares

The identity **a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)** is used to simplify calculations involving the subtraction of two squared numbers.

Square of Sum and Difference

Related identities include (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² and (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b².</p
